messages.subject: math formula in sequenza paper supplement
parts:
Hi Francesco,

I try to understand the math model behind sequenza through reading the supplement of the sequenza paper. I think I getting a hang on it. But I'm a little confused with last part of formular (6) : 1/[(psi*rho)*2*(1-rho)]

What does (psi*rho)*2*(1-rho) means? May be it should be "(psi*rho)+2*(1-rho)"?

~ Jessie

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: math formula in sequenza paper supplement
parts:
Hi Jessie,

Yes, I'm aware of the typo... I've noticed right after the printed version was out. I need to send an errata to the editor... sorry for not fixing it immediately.

The correct equation is, as you wrote, (psi*rho)+2*(1-rho) (I missed the + in the latex equation, for some reasons...)
Thanks for noticing :).
As you can see in the R code "theoretical.depth.ratio" the formula it's actually correct. 

Best

Francesco
